title: Union Bank of India UBI Apprentices Result 2026
postName: Engagement of Apprentices under Apprentices Act, 1961
vacancyDetails: 1865 Apprentice posts under Apprentices Act 1961 – one year apprenticeship with stipend
qualification: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university on or before 01 April 2026; degree not older than 4 years (after 01 April 2022); local language proficiency mandatory
ageLimit: 20 to 28 years as on 01 April 2026 (relaxations as per bank/govt rules)
selectionProcess: Online Written Test → Local Language Test → Document Verification → Engagement
documentsRequired: Graduation certificate/mark sheets, DOB proof, category certificate, photo ID, local language proof, Aadhaar
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.unionbankofindia.bank.in
2. Go to Careers / Recruitment
3. Open List of Provisionally Selected Candidates for Engagement of Apprentices PDF
4. Search your Roll Number / Name
5. Follow further instructions for document verification and engagement
shortDescription: Union Bank of India has released the Apprentice Result 2026 for 1865 posts. Online exam was held on 7 June 2026; provisionally selected list is out on the bank website.
content:
Union Bank of India has declared the result for Engagement of 1865 Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

The online examination was conducted on 7 June 2026. The list of provisionally selected candidates was published on 25 July 2026 on the official recruitment page.

Key details

  • Total vacancies: 1865
  • Stipend: approx. ₹15,000/month (rural/semi-urban) as per notification
  • Duration: 1 year apprenticeship
  • Also check waitlist / cancellation notices if published on the same page

Candidates must complete document verification as per bank instructions. Official portal: unionbankofindia.bank.in.
